label: PLANET IGS-5225-8P4S-12V
description: PLANET IGS-5225-8P4S-12V industrial L2+ managed PoE switch with a 12 V booster for battery and solar sites: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T 802.3af/at PoE+ RJ45 (36 W a port), 2x 100/1000BASE-X SFP (ports 9-10), 2x 100/1000/2500BASE-X SFP (ports 11-12), PoE budget 60 W on 12 V DC, 120 W on 24 V DC and 240 W on 48-54 V DC, 30 Gbps non-blocking fabric, 22.32 Mpps, -40 to 75 C.

poe.note: 240 W maximum on a 48-54 V DC feed. The same switch gives 120 W on 24 V DC and only 60 W on 12 V DC, which is the point of the -12V variant: it boosts a 12 V battery or solar bus up to PoE voltage. Modelled at the 240 W ceiling, so a 12 V deployment must be read as 60 W - two 30 W ports, not eight.

fabric.note: 30 Gbps non-blocking and 22.32 Mpps at 64 bytes, 8K MAC table, 4 Mbit shared buffer.

notes: Hardware version 1 per the shared IGS-5225-8P series datasheet; every figure here is taken from the current product page specification table. Dual 12-54 V DC input, 7.28 W idle and 249 W fully loaded, 76.8 x 107.3 x 152 mm, 1128 g, RJ45-to-RS232 console at 115200 8-N-1. Unverifiable detail: the page's LED table lists a 'Per 10/100/1000T RJ45 Ports' group in addition to the PoE port group, but the port table and the ordering description both give 8 copper ports, so 8 is modelled and the extra LED group is treated as a copy-paste leftover rather than two hidden data-only RJ45s.
